title: Kirksey Recreation Center | Livonia, MI
content:
The Rec closes each year for deep cleaning and maintenance, traditionally scheduled just before Labor Day. Although major construction halted shutdowns in 2024 and 2025, this annual maintenance week has been part of operations since 2003. During the closure, members may still use the Clements Circle Splash Park.

This year’s projects include:

- Lobby ceiling painting

- High dusting and carpet cleaning

- Re‑grouting locker room showers

- Painting Gyms 3 and 4

- And more! [...] - And more!

Management continues to refine the process, and the five‑day shutdown remains the most efficient way to keep the facility in top condition.
